# Raster input fixtures

All images here are original synthetic rectangles generated by this project;
no personal images or third-party artwork are used. The repository license
applies. Regenerate from the root with:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m tools.generate_input_fixtures
```

Generation uses Pillow 12.3.0 and pillow-heif 1.8.1 (libheif 1.23.6).
The files are versioned so tests and frozen checks decode known, real inputs;
no HEIF encoder is needed to run these checks.

- `sample.*`: 96 × 64 RGB image (red with a blue upper-right quadrant).
- `oriented.heic`: the RGB image with EXIF orientation 6, an author tag and sRGB ICC.
- `primary-second.heif`: two images; the primary is index 1, an 80 × 120 RGBA
  green image with alpha 128 and a fully transparent upper-left corner.
- `sequence.avif`: red/blue first frame; green second frame, same dimensions.
- `alpha.avif`: the same 80 × 120 RGBA primary pattern.
- `animated.gif`: transparent first frame with an opaque red rectangle;
  second frame is green.
- `pages.tiff`: red/blue 96 × 64 first page; green 64 × 96 second page.
- `sample.ico`: 16, 32 and 64 px representations of the RGBA primary pattern.
